text: {"fixes":[{"element_id":"s03.e02","problem":"The 'My Chats' title box is 84px wide but the real one is 304px wide, so it is measured as misplaced.","fix":"Make the title element 304.4px wide, x=59, y=14.5, h=27.1, with left-aligned text (e.g. width:304px on the h1/div). Use 20px Roboto medium, white, and shift the baseline about 1px lower to match the real screen."},{"element_id":"s04.e02","problem":"The 'Notifications' title box is 114.8px wide but the real one is 304.4px, so it is off by more than 4px.","fix":"Set the title element to x=59, y=14.5, w=304.4, h=27.1 with left-aligned text. Text stays 20px, white, and sits about 1-2px lower than now."},{"element_id":"s15.e16","problem":"The small '8' text tag at the left of the '10,000 characters' row is missing. The mock shows the count as one string with no separate tagged element.","fix":"Add a visible element tagged data-el s15.e16 at x=15.6, y=261.3, w=8, h=16, holding the first digit of the count in 14px Roboto, white, so '10,000' reads as before."},{"element_id":"s15.e32","problem":"The Dr. Stein card art is not drawn at its rect. The image is offset and shows a lighter strip at the top, and the heatmap shows a mismatch.","fix":"Draw assets/s15.e32.art.png at exactly x=24, y=319.3, w=152.3, h=188.1 with object-fit:fill. Remove any extra overlay or gradient on top of it."},{"element_id":"s15.e56","problem":"The Dean Winchester art is not exactly at its rect.","fix":"Draw assets/s15.e56.art.png at x=218.7, y=319.3, w=155.7, h=188.1 with no scaling or cropping offset."},{"element_id":"s15.e45","problem":"The '👨 Male' tag box is 17px tall at y=705.9. It should be 11.4px tall at y=708.6.","fix":"Make the tag text box h=11.4 with line-height 11.4px, at x=98.3, y=708.6, w=36.6. Keep the pill background separate from the tagged text box. Use the same emoji glyph as the real screen."},{"element_id":"s15.e49","problem":"The '👤 AnyPOV' tag box is 17px tall and 2.7px too high. The emoji renders differently from the real one.","fix":"Set the box to x=100.6, y=734.9, w=51, h=11.4 with line-height 11.4px. Use the real bust-in-silhouette emoji and 12px text."},{"element_id":"s17","problem":"The background is a flat navy with a regular dot grid. The real one is a deep-blue starfield with nebula glow, which the heatmap shows as a large diffuse mismatch. The title and 'janitor+' logo also use a different font and letterforms: the logo shows a cat-eye ring instead of the spiral 'o'.","fix":"Replace the dot grid with a soft radial-gradient background: #0b1030 base, a lighter #26356e glow at about 60% y, and a faint purple tint at the bottom. Sprinkle only a few tiny random stars. Tighten the serif title letter-spacing so 'More memory for long chats.' is a bit narrower and lighter in weight. Draw the logo with a spiral 'o' instead of the cat-eye circle. Render the golden checkmark as a badge with a scalloped edge."},{"element_id":"s03","problem":"The chat rows differ slightly: the titles sit about 1px too high, and the star glyph and text are rendered slightly bolder and wider. This shows red on all the names.","fix":"Set the row titles to 16px Roboto weight 500. Shift them down 1px. Use the letter-spacing that makes '⭐ Rodrick Heffley!' end at about x=203. Make the time text and chevrons match the real gray, #b8b8bd."},{"element_id":"s04","problem":"The header icon and title look bolder than the real ones. The gear is a filled cog rather than an outline gear. The bottom nav cat icon is a flat gray cat instead of the spiral logo.","fix":"Use a thin-stroke outline gear icon (2px stroke, 22px). Remove the text-shadow on 'No notifications' and the title. Set the nav center icon to the gray spiral-cat outline like the real one."}],"summary":"The mock is close, with no contract errors or failed taps. The misses are the two title elements, which are too narrow, and the missing '8' element on s15. This round should fix those boxes, then align the art rects and the tag pill boxes, and rebuild the s17 starfield background and logo, where the SSIM is lowest."}
